prompt_practice_1.name: practice_1
prompt_practice_1.label: One-off label
prompt_practice_1.prompt:
### Practice 1

| 1. Swim | 2. Chicken | 3. Rest  | 4. Ski  |
| ------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- |
| 5. Book | 6. Sit     | 7. Dance | 8. Pray |

How would you classify this label?

> **Dance**

prompt_practice_2.name: practice_2
prompt_practice_2.label: Systematic label
prompt_practice_2.prompt:
### Practice 2

| 1. pby red    | 2. pby short | 3. orb tall | 4. orb legs |
| ------------- | ------------ | ----------- | ----------- |
| 5. orb circle | 6. orb short | 7. pby wide | 8. pby tall |

How would you classify this label?

> **orb tall**
